_about: Players kept in the PROSPECT slot, by the season they were kept in.
A prospect keep never sets the $5 tax flag, but ESPN cannot tell you which of its four
keeper picks was the prospect — draftSettings.keeperCount is 4 (3 keepers + 1 prospect)
and the draft pick carries no slot. So the distinction has to be recorded by hand.
Human-owned, like everything in data/manual/. The nightly Action READS this and must
never write it. Superseded once the Phase 4 admin tool records full KeeperClaim rows with
their slots -- at that point derive this from claims where slot == PROSPECT and delete it.
Source: the Keepers workbook's 'Fee Allocations' tabs, Prospect column.

_notes.4428557: Tyjae Spears — Purdy Good at Fantasy, P_Sal $3. Taxing him was a real $5 error.
